Carmen (Billing): Heads-up 1 noticed a cardholder dispute for invoice INV-2237 (merchant NeonCart acct_NC881). Cardholder says they were charged after merchant voided the order. Dispute id dsp_NC_2026_03. Stripe link: https://dashboard.stripe.com/disputes/dsp_NC_2026_03
Omar (Risk): Do we have evidence the merchant issued a void/cancel before capture? Need timestamps of invoice update, refund/void, and charge capture.
billing-bot: System alert: invoice_status_changed for INV-2237: created 2026-03-19T14:02:10Z -> voided 2026-03-20T09:15:03Z -> charge_capture ch_9zYb at 2026-03-20T09:15:25Z (10s after void). Possible race condition. Risk score: 69%.
Carmen (Billing): Ugh, looks like our capture webhook processed after merchant void due to delayed event ordering. Posting webhook trace: ```[2026-03-20T09:15:03Z] invoice.voided id=inv_2237
[2026-03-20T09:15:25Z] charge.captured id=ch_9zYb
[2026-03-20T09:15:30Z] refund.created id=re_55Q (merchant requested)```
Izzy (Support): I messaged the merchant rep asking for their internal order log and whether they authorized the capture. They replied: "We voided, but our payment provider retried the capture once due to a delayed ack. Attaching PID logs."
Ravi (FinOps): We need to avoid double exposure: if merchant confirms accidental capture we should attempt reversal with the gateway and ask cardholder to withdraw dispute. But if cardholder insists, prepare representment. I recommend holding the merchant payout for this single transaction until resolved.
Legal: Reminder: preserve chain-of-auth and merchant confirmation email if we contest. Also keep timezone-stamped logs.
Omar (Risk): Action items: 1) Collect merchant PID logs and signed confirmation that void was intended; 2) Pull our webhook delivery timings and ordering from event log (evt_9912); 3) Draft representment evidence only if merchant provides documentation showing service was not delivered.
Carmen (Billing): I've added portal note: "Chargeback dsp_NC_2026_03 under review 1 potential race capture after void. Holding payout for INV-2237." Ledger tag: lr_nc_2237. Evidence bucket: /shared/finance/neoncart/dsp_NC_2026_03.
billing-bot: Reminder scheduled in 24h for merchant evidence upload.
Izzy (Support): Merchant uploaded their order management export and a short note: "Confirmed void before capture; capture was gateway retry." They said they will send a signed attestation within 48h.
Ravi (FinOps): Provisional approval to reverse that single capture if merchant attests and gateway supports reversal. Otherwise await dispute outcome.
Omar (Risk): I'll start drafting an explanation of event ordering for representment and annotate the webhook traces. ETA 3 hours.
Carmen (Billing): Thanks team. I'll update thread when attestation arrives or if cardholder retracts dispute.
